One locked-off 10-second live-action observational shot of a serious Korean care-facility recruitment interview, viewed from the seated applicant's eyes. Preserve exactly the three fictional adults, faces, apparent ages, hairstyle, clothing, glasses, pens, desk, papers, room, daylight direction, exposure and camera crop in the supplied original room-reference image. Hands stay anatomically plausible and pens keep the same shape.
